svg.text: Users, courses and curriculum, enrollments, assignments and quizzes
Navigation, home page, pages, products, payment methods and settings

• Announcements.CreatedByUserId points to Tbl_Users logically (no FK constraint). • A Batches table (with BatchId on Announcements, Assignments, Enrollments, LiveClasses) exists on the master branch and in the local database, but not in this branch's model classes, so it is not drawn.
• RelatedProductViewModel is a plain class listed in Product.RelatedProducts, so EF maps it to its own table with a nullable ProductId.
